mating-face.src: SAE J1962 16-pin diagnostic plug mating face: the vehicle socket has pins 1-8 on the upper row and 9-16 on the lower row left to right; the plug is its mirror image (approximate trapezoid outline). Drawn for WireHub from public dimensions; CC0-1.0, not traced from any vendor drawing.
